name: Woodfire Steak & More
kurzbeschreibung:
**Woodfire Steak & More in Innsbruck**

Discover the perfect blend of hearty flavors and alpine charm at **Woodfire Steak & More** in **Innsbruck**. Savor our signature **Woodfire Steak**, cooked to perfection over an open flame, paired with fresh local sides. Indulge in a classic **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert or enjoy a cozy **Apfelstrudel** with a warm cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** fondue. Whether you're craving a juicy steak, crispy **Schnitzel**, or a comforting bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**, our menu has something for every palate.

After your meal, take a stroll through **Innsbruck’s** historic old town or relax with a **Schnaps** by the fireplace. Experience authentic **Tirol** hospitality in the heart of the city—where every bite tells a story of tradition and taste.
